event.description: Remove the never-forwarded final positional row
event.proposal: Family: position representation. Current retained frontier is 2,144 parameters at 99.140000%, a +0.140000 percentage-point margin over 99%. There have been 4 prior attempts in this family. There is no accepted in-family result; the most recent failed result is attempt-0025, whose centered rank-10 positional approximation scored 32.44% at 3,018 parameters. Attempt-0029 has since established the 2,144-parameter fully shared-transform frontier. Hypothesis: row 32 of the 33-row positional table is provably unused: teacher-forced inputs have length 32 after shifting, and the eleventh generation token is appended after the final length-32 forward pass. Cropping that row and attention masks exactly preserves every evaluated computation while yielding 2,128 parameters. This is more informative than the nearest untested lossy positional factorization because it removes a structurally unreachable parameter row with zero approximation error, crucial given the incumbent's narrow margin.
